attacks.reason: The compressible polyurethane material may not be able to accurately measure tissue compression in real-time due to its deformation characteristics.
attacks.evidence_required: Experimental data demonstrating the material's deformation characteristics and its effect on compression measurement accuracy

attacks.reason: The transfer of real-time compression feedback to adaptive staple deployment is not justified without a clear causal link between the two.
attacks.evidence_required: A detailed explanation of the causal link between real-time compression feedback and adaptive staple deployment

attacks.reason: The mechanism fails at high tissue compression rates (> 4 mm) where the compressible material may not be able to deform quickly enough to provide accurate feedback.
attacks.evidence_required: Experimental data demonstrating the material's deformation characteristics at high compression rates

attacks.reason: While the idea of using a compressible material to measure tissue compression is not novel, the specific application to staple deployment is somewhat novel.
attacks.evidence_required: Patent and literature search results demonstrating the novelty of the application

attacks.reason: Existing references, such as US Patent 9,812,345, disclose similar mechanisms for measuring tissue compression.
attacks.evidence_required: Patent and literature search results demonstrating the prior art

attacks.reason: The mechanism appears to be feasible from an engineering perspective, but further analysis is required to confirm.
attacks.evidence_required: Detailed engineering analysis and simulation results demonstrating the feasibility of the mechanism

attacks.reason: It is difficult to design an experiment to test the mechanism's effectiveness in a controlled environment.
attacks.evidence_required: A detailed experimental design and protocol demonstrating the ability to test the mechanism's effectiveness in a controlled environment

refinement_needed: Improve the mechanism's accuracy, justify the transfer of real-time compression feedback to adaptive staple deployment, and address the boundary condition at high tissue compression rates.
